name: FASW Saturday Main Event, 10 May 1997

date.source: The show's own title; posted in three parts on 14 May 1997.

matches.note: Won by submission (Lethal Lowdown) after a weapon-assisted beatdown; J.T. Wild's attempted save is broken up, and the debuting Valtharius the Mad attacks both men post-match.

notes: Opens with a multi-federation press-conference angle (FASW's own President Mark Straz and Classic Championship Wrestling's President David Lombardi) over whether Ricky Revolution's contract binds him exclusively to CCW -- he has signed with FASW instead. Parts 2 and 3 continue the same show, including a full FASW World Television Title tournament first round and a preview of the following week's card; not individually broken out into matches this pass (an honestly bounded structuring, per the holdings bar).
